# Contradictory Project Fixture

The project described in this fixture is entirely fictional and fully
anonymized. It contains no confidential information and exists exclusively
for methodological validation of the `project-design` plugin.

## Purpose

Represent a consulting engagement where plausible source artefacts describe
the same project with conflicting expectations, priorities, rules, dates, and
technical assumptions. The source artefacts do not identify or resolve those
conflicts.

## Fictional Context

`Copper Meadow Association` is a fictional organization. Its proposed `Member
Service Portal` is a fictional application.

## Source Artefacts

Provide all of the following files to the skill under test:

- [Project charter](project-charter.md)
- [Sponsor message](sponsor-message.md)
- [Operations workshop](operations-workshop.md)
- [Service policy extract](service-policy-extract.md)
- [Technical assumptions](technical-assumptions.md)
- [Delivery plan](delivery-plan.md)

This README describes the fixture and is not project source material.

The directory may later accommodate additional source artefacts such as
diagrams, specifications, decision logs, API notes, or user documentation.
